front: Who can read system tables by default?
back: Users who are both account admin and metastore admin. Người khác cần `USE CATALOG`, `USE SCHEMA` và `SELECT` trên schema hệ thống.
It is an SCD2 table: keep the latest `change_time` per `workspace_id, job_id`, then drop rows with `delete_time`. Mỗi lần sửa hoặc xoá job sinh thêm một dòng.
Runs are sliced into rows of up to one hour; `result_state` and `termination_code` appear only on the final slice. Slice giữa có `result_state` NULL.
They negate an incorrect `ORIGINAL` record (negative `usage_quantity`); sum all record types. `RESTATEMENT` chứa giá trị đã sửa.

front: Convert DBUs to USD with system tables
back: Join `system.billing.list_prices` on `sku_name` and the price validity window, multiply by `pricing.default`. Đây là list price, không phải giá sau chiết khấu.

ref.label: Monitor job costs & performance with system tables

front: Runs from `runs/submit` (for example Airflow) in system tables
back: `run_type = 'SUBMIT_RUN'`, visible only in the timeline tables, not in `jobs` or `job_tasks`. Trên Jobs UI tìm theo Run ID hoặc Run as.

front: Retention of run history in the Jobs UI and Jobs API
back: 60 days; use `system.lakeflow` tables (395 days) or export results for longer history. Run và output tự xoá sau 60 ngày.
Output and metadata of a single task run, including the `dbutils.notebook.exit()` value, first 5 MB only. Gọi với task run ID, không phải job run nhiều task.

front: Who can query a pipeline event log by default?
back: Only the pipeline's run-as user, through `event_log(<pipeline_id>)` on a hidden Delta table. Publish event log hoặc tạo view để chia sẻ.

front: Event log field for expectation pass and fail counts
back: `details:flow_progress.data_quality.expectations` in `flow_progress` events. Số record bị drop ở `data_quality.dropped_records`.
`system.lakeflow_pipeline_events_preview.pipeline_events` (Beta): events of all pipelines in the region, the recommended way to query events. Thay cho việc đọc event log từng pipeline.

ref.label: Monitor and query events (pipeline_events system table)

back: `OK`, `TRIGGERED`, `ERROR`; the legacy `UNKNOWN` state is gone; a SQL alert task can pass values to the alert query parameters. Bản mới GA ngày 14/05/2026.

front: What does a repair run rerun?
back: Only unsuccessful tasks and their dependents, using the current job and task settings. Repair chỉ cho job có từ 2 task trở lên.
Not needed on the first repair, required on every later repair of the same run; take it from the returned `repair_id`. Đảm bảo các lần repair diễn ra tuần tự.

ref.label: Jobs API 2.2, Repair a job run

back: Prefix `[dev <user>]`, pipelines `development: true`, schedules paused, concurrent runs allowed, no deployment lock, `--cluster-id` override. Dùng cho target dev.
Pipelines must be `development: false`; current Git branch must equal `git.branch` unless `--force`; recommends `run_as` service principal. Không cho override cluster.
Repos. Git folders có thể đặt ở mọi độ sâu dưới `/Workspace/Users/<email>/`, path `/Repos` cũ vẫn chạy.

front: Staging and prod jobs: Git folder path or remote Git source?
back: Remote Git source on the job: each run snapshots a branch, tag or commit. Databricks khuyên chỉ dùng path Git folder khi phát triển.
Not available, and neither are Spark logs; use the query profile and `system.query.history`. Đây là giới hạn của serverless.

front: Current jobs from the SCD2 table `system.lakeflow.jobs`
back: Take the latest `change_time` row per `workspace_id, job_id` first, then filter `delete_time IS NULL`. Lọc `delete_time` trước thì job đã xoá vẫn hiện với trạng thái cũ.

front: SQL alert task status when the alert condition is triggered
back: Succeeded; the task fails only on evaluation errors. Rẽ nhánh theo evaluation state trong task output, không theo status của task.
`system.alert.alerts` (configuration history) and `system.alert.alert_evaluation_history` (each evaluation and delivery status), 395 days. Dùng để audit alert.
`+task` adds upstream tasks, `task+` adds downstream tasks, e.g. `--only load_silver+`. Đây là run mới, không phải repair.

front: Streaming backlog notification never fires on a notebook job
back: Jobs must track the active streaming query; remove `awaitTermination()`. Backlog lấy trung bình 10 phút và không áp cho pipeline task.

front: Repair a run that contains a disabled task
back: Repairs use run state, not disabled state; list the task in `rerun_tasks` to force it to run. Task disabled không tự chạy lại.
